# Run Javascript For Automation

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Executes a JXA script for Mac Automation.

## Syntax

~~~~text
javascriptForAutomation(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>, script: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
javascriptForAutomation(input: ShortcutInput, script: "console.log(\")
~~~~
